name: inventario-alquiler-implementos
description: Sistema de administración de inventario y alquiler de implementos de construcción

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate --workspace backend && npm run prisma:deploy --workspace backend && npm run prisma:seed --workspace backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
